The Chinese characters for Wyatt

As a transliteration, Wyatt is usually written 怀亚特 (Huái yà tè). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

怀
Huái
bosom, cherish
亚
yà
Asia, second
特
tè
special

Origin and meaning

The name Wyatt has English roots and means “brave in war”.

About the name Wyatt

Wyatt Earp, the lawman of the American frontier, bore this name.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Wyatt carries the meaning “brave in war” and looks striking in brush strokes.
